name: Combat Condition
description: Combat conditions evaluated by creature AI (e.g. creature spell lists): an optional worldstate expression, unit conditions on self and current target, and counted unit conditions over nearby friends and enemies on the threat list.

fields.name: Worldstate Expression
fields.help: worldstate_expression.Id which must evaluate to true; 0 = no worldstate requirement.

fields.name: Self Condition
fields.help: unit_condition.Id checked on the creature itself; 0 = none.

fields.name: Self Condition Editor
fields.help: Edit the unit condition referenced by Self Condition.

fields.name: Target Condition
fields.help: unit_condition.Id checked on the creature's current target; 0 = none.

fields.name: Target Condition Editor
fields.help: Edit the unit condition referenced by Target Condition.

fields.name: Friend Condition Logic
fields.help: How the two friend condition checks are combined.

fields.name: Enemy Condition Logic
fields.help: How the two enemy condition checks are combined.

fields.name: Friend Condition 0
fields.help: unit_condition.Id counted over nearby friendly units; 0 = none (skips the whole friend check).

fields.name: Friend Condition 0 Editor
fields.help: Edit the unit condition referenced by Friend Condition 0.

fields.name: Friend Condition 1
fields.help: unit_condition.Id counted over nearby friendly units; 0 = none.

fields.name: Friend Condition 1 Editor
fields.help: Edit the unit condition referenced by Friend Condition 1.

fields.name: Friend Condition Op 0
fields.help: Comparison of the number of friends fulfilling condition 0 against Friend Condition Count 0.

fields.name: Friend Condition Op 1
fields.help: Comparison of the number of friends fulfilling condition 1 against Friend Condition Count 1.

fields.name: Friend Condition Count 0
fields.help: Number of friends compared using Friend Condition Op 0.

fields.name: Friend Condition Count 1
fields.help: Number of friends compared using Friend Condition Op 1.

fields.name: Enemy Condition 0
fields.help: unit_condition.Id counted over enemies on the threat list; 0 = none (skips the whole enemy check).

fields.name: Enemy Condition 0 Editor
fields.help: Edit the unit condition referenced by Enemy Condition 0.

fields.name: Enemy Condition 1
fields.help: unit_condition.Id counted over enemies on the threat list; 0 = none.

fields.name: Enemy Condition 1 Editor
fields.help: Edit the unit condition referenced by Enemy Condition 1.

fields.name: Enemy Condition Op 0
fields.help: Comparison of the number of enemies fulfilling condition 0 against Enemy Condition Count 0.

fields.name: Enemy Condition Op 1
fields.help: Comparison of the number of enemies fulfilling condition 1 against Enemy Condition Count 1.

fields.name: Enemy Condition Count 0
fields.help: Number of enemies compared using Enemy Condition Op 0.

fields.name: Enemy Condition Count 1
fields.help: Number of enemies compared using Enemy Condition Op 1.
